items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...interviewed Zilmer Randolph... said it was really a good band. [INTERVIEWEE] It was. Yes, it was.

ctx.x: Never -- no, I don't think so.
But I've read about it. And I interviewed Zilmer Randolph on the same project that I'm doing you. And he was telling me about that band, said it was really a good band.
